text: COORDINATOR HINT (a reviewer read your trace -- a lead to weigh, not an order): Your solver answers only about 593 of 1495 fields on this variant. The "no value" lines are concentrated in the new file types: rb, pl, php, gs, groovy, csx, lua, ts, mof, proj, nsi, yml, gd, au3, ahk and applescript. They use `HUNTRESS_ANALYSIS_V1:LYR-<chain>-<payload>` markers, such as `LYR-hex_b32_rev-` and `LYR-hex_hex_hex`. The single_solve case has no LYR markers at all, only HEX, HB64, FRAG, SPLIT and B64. Don't keep comparing cases. Write a LYR decoder that applies the named chain in order, reversing where `rev` appears and decoding each hex, b32 or b64 step. Check it against the GM-verified `expected.json` values for polyglot-lua, php and groovy. Then wire it into solve.py.
